arabic text:
MAZLUM-E HUSEIN PAR, GIRYAAN HAI QAAENAAT,
SHABBIR SAA HUWAA NA GHARIBUL WATAN KOI
english translation text:
For the oppressed Hussain, all of creation weeps.
Never was there another exile Like Shabbir.

arabic text:
KEH-DE KOI ZAMIN SE NIGAL, LE FURAAT KO,
SAAHIL PE TIN DIN SE HAI TASHNAA DAHAN KOI
english translation text:
Let someone command the earth to swallow up the Euphrates. For upon
its banks stands one Whose lips have been thirsty for three days.

arabic text:
ASGHER KE MUNH KO CHUM KE, KHUN RO-DIYE HUSEIN,
YAAD AA-GAYI SAGHIR KI BICHHDI BAHAN KOI
english translation text:
Kissing Asghar upon the face, Hussain wept tears of blood.
He remembered A little sister left behind in separation.

arabic text:
BARCHHI KAA PHAL KALE-JE MEN, PAIWAST JAB HUWAA,
TADPAA SULAGTI RET PAR GUL PAIRAHAN KOI
english translation text:
When the spearhead pierced his chest, A
flower-clad youth writhed Upon the burning sands.
